title: Scatter
version_reading_depth: Live Houdini 22.0; overview and selected seeding/order/relaxation/attachment sections
lesson_and_limit: Stable positions do not imply stable point indices. Primitive seeding and bounded relaxation have specific scopes; no universal identity guarantee.

title: Scatter and Align
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; workflow, scaling, constraints and relevant parameters
lesson_and_limit: Separate population constraints, overlap removal and moving-point relaxation. Its normalized-source scale convention must not be assumed in Cyrus.

title: Attribute From Pieces
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; overview and assignment attributes
lesson_and_limit: Asset-piece assignment is a distinct stage. Piece labels and source-size conventions require declared meanings.

title: Copying and instancing point attributes
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; short attribute/precedence reference
lesson_and_limit: Orientation, scale, pivot and matrix precedence are explicit contracts. Max conversion needs its own verified conventions.

title: Attribute Interpolate
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; parameter reference before navigation index
lesson_and_limit: Primitive coordinates or element weights encode correspondence. They do not automatically survive remeshing.

title: Copy to Points
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; overview and relevant parameters
lesson_and_limit: Piece matching and packed shared geometry separate assignment from geometry duplication. No cross-host memory/performance equivalence is established.

title: Wedge TOP
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; overview, generation and target-parameter selection sections
lesson_and_limit: Useful variation attributes and sweeps; selecting work can optionally alter parameters. Gallery browsing should not implicitly apply a candidate.

title: Cooking/Executing TOP networks
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; dirtying and execution sections
lesson_and_limit: Intermediate result-file changes are not automatically a sufficient dependency signal. Validate artifacts on reuse/resume.

title: pdg.WorkItem
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; selected cache methods
lesson_and_limit: Explicit cache invalidation exists. This is an analogy for an owned artifact contract, not a recommendation to add PDG.

title: Local Scheduler
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; slots, memory/time limits and success/failure policies
lesson_and_limit: Admission, process execution and semantic success are distinct. Do not equate a slot with an internal thread or a succeeded task with a valid render.

title: Wait for All
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; partition timing, failed inputs and split attributes
lesson_and_limit: Partition options can omit failed or missing inputs. Cyrus must explicitly require the complete expected view set.

title: ML overview
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; overview of utilities, building blocks and training
lesson_and_limit: Procedural data and external training can form a pipeline. The existence of a toolchain does not create aesthetic supervision.

title: ML stages
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; full short conceptual page
lesson_and_limit: Forward approximation, inverse prediction, preprocessing and held-out evaluation are separate concerns. Small classical models remain valid baselines.

title: ONNX inference
version_reading_depth: Live 22.0; input/output tensor and execution-provider sections
lesson_and_limit: Tensor layout and execution backend matter. ONNX is an optional deployment format, not a requirement for the first Cyrus ranker.

title: Python threading
version_reading_depth: Max 2027; short page rechecked; also S38
lesson_and_limit: Keep worker Python away from `pymxs`. This does not forbid all carefully designed native parallel computation.

title: ReferenceTarget
version_reading_depth: Max 2027; `NotifyDependents` contract and relevant propagation details
lesson_and_limit: Notification interval and cache validity differ. Trace initiators because propagated references need not identify the original source.

title: Rendering notifications
version_reading_depth: Max 2027; full short event reference
lesson_and_limit: Setup/teardown and per-frame phases have different mutation permissions. Actual third-party renderer behaviour still needs runtime tests.

title: General callback mechanism
version_reading_depth: Max 2027; registration, removal, inspection and event-name sections
lesson_and_limit: Own callback registrations; function redefinition is not replacement. `notificationEvent()` is a 2027 addition, so diagnostic paths need version gating.

title: System notification codes
version_reading_depth: Max 2027; selected render notifications; matched local `notify.h`
lesson_and_limit: Native phase contracts corroborate the MAXScript distinction. Not all notification payloads or SDK events were audited.

title: GeomObject
version_reading_depth: Max 2027; render-mesh ownership and multi-mesh transform sections
lesson_and_limit: A future direct adapter must obey mesh ownership/space/validity contracts. This does not prove a defect in the current PFlow path.

title: TexmapThreadSafe
version_reading_depth: Max 2027; detailed description and deprecation contract
lesson_and_limit: Texture evaluation has a specific multithreaded prepared-data contract. The deprecated opt-in interface is not a recommended new implementation.

title: Hold
version_reading_depth: Max 2027; Begin, Accept, Cancel and nesting remarks
lesson_and_limit: Balanced host Undo differs from persistent workflow history. A crashed process is not an automatic cancelled transaction.

title: Time and intervals
version_reading_depth: **Max 2026**; full short overview; equivalent 2027 overview URL unavailable
lesson_and_limit: Validity can avoid repeated evaluation. Use matching SDK/API contracts before changing a concrete 2027 implementation.

title: Node Event System
version_reading_depth: Max 2027; lifecycle, timer, polling and event sections
lesson_and_limit: UI/message-loop dependence is a concrete Batch qualification concern. Node events do not replace every other callback mechanism.

title: 3ds Max Batch usage
version_reading_depth: **Max 2022**; command execution and process-return sections; same 2027 URL unavailable
lesson_and_limit: Process/initialization outcomes are separate from domain artifact validity. Current Batch/renderer support remains unqualified.
